Ākārādayaś ca dharmāḥ pṛthivyādīnāṃ krameṇa śāstre paripaṭhitāḥ / Yathā--
Ākāro gauravaṃ raukṣyaṃ varaṇaṃ sthairyam eva ca /
Vṛttir bhedaḥ kṣamā kārśyaṃ kāṭhinyaṃ sarvabhogyatā //
Snehaḥ saukṣmyaṃ prabhā śauklyaṃ mārdavaṃ gauravaṃ ca yat /
Śaityaṃ rakṣā pavitratvaṃ saṃdhānaṃ caudakā guṇāḥ //
ªrdhvabhāk pācakaṃ dagdhṛ pāvakaṃ laghu bhāsvaram /
Pradhvaṃsyojasvi vai tejaḥ pūrvebhyo bhinnalakṣaṇam //
Tiryagyānaṃ pavitratvam ākṣepo nodanaṃ balam /
Calam acchāyatā raukṣyaṃ vāyor dharmāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ //
Sarvato gatir avyūho'viṣṭambhaś ceti
